measurement: perf_counter_ns around subprocess.run with both output streams captured; includes process launch and output capture
order: Each round shuffles the workloads and randomly chooses baseline/candidate order within each pair.
cache: Warm filesystem cache after warmups. No eviction, network, transport, digest, or signature work is measured.
limitations: One native host; no cross-architecture comparison
Host scheduling and other work can affect elapsed time
Local catalog search does not represent network installation or whole-application performance
publication_note: Public edition: executor-local absolute paths are replaced with logical labels. Numeric observations, output checks, technical metadata, and recorded digests are unchanged. See public-redaction.json for field substitutions and original/public file hashes.
